c74object.name: sunny.hold~
c74object.digest: Hold a bounded message value as a signal
c74object.description: Generate one mono signal containing the most recently accepted normalized message value. Message controls are serialized outside the audio callback and take effect in order at the next signal-vector boundary. This object has no signal sampler or trigger inlet.

method.name: float
method.description: Accept a finite value from -1 through 1 at the next vector boundary.

method.name: value
method.description: Accept a finite value from -1 through 1 at the next vector boundary.

method.name: reset
method.digest: Reset the held value to zero

method.name: status
method.description: Post configuration, setup, control, current pending-control, process, and last-error evidence to the Max console. The right message outlet also emits the closed tuple `host_status configured sample_rate maximum_frames process_observed process_calls last_frame_count process_healthy last_error`; `process_calls` is an exact signed saturating callback count and the left outlet remains the sole signal outlet.

method.name: clear_error
method.description: Clear the last-error code without clearing counters, the held value, or DSP state.
